corrections.old_text: A scientific theory is a tested explanation supported by evidence, rather than an untested opinion; evolutionary science continues to investigate its details.
corrections.new_text: A scientific theory is a tested explanation supported by evidence, rather than an untested opinion; evolutionary science continues to investigate its details.
corrections.reason: The directly read Smithsonian FAQ supports both the tested-evidence meaning of scientific theory and continued investigation of evolutionary details; its citation was omitted from the source list.

reference_additions.title: Frequently Asked Questions
reference_additions.supports: Under “What do scientists mean when they call evolution a theory?” the page describes a well-tested explanation supported by abundant evidence; under “Isn’t evolution controversial among scientists?” it says research continues into the details of how evolution occurred.
